description: Cs₂NaMoCl₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Cs is bonded to twelve equivalent Cl atoms to form CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent MoCl₆ octahedra. All Cs-Cl bond lengths are 3.76 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.83 Å. Mo is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form MoCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Mo-Cl bond lengths are 2.47 Å. Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Mo atom.
